reason: Brings the GUI's follow-up queue and model/tool choices to the paired terminal client: numbered /queue with add (held for later when idle), edit, move up/down/first/last, remove, retry, pause/resume/clear and 'Send one now'; /now stop-and-send (pause, enqueue first, cancel, resume); /model through Core's checked runtime switch also from a harness, with unverified-model verification, one 409 retry and deferred-activation notice; chat choices remembered as project assistant defaults and applied to new chats; /mcp delivery states, tool-schema mode and next-turn exclusions; 'Always allow' standing tool-result consent saved on the runtime; harness session resume for new harness chats; remove-all attachments. Rebased on main 936b5d5 (after #1038); shared docs, catalog and packaging entries keep both features. Selected: the new followups unit contracts, shell and TUI suites, the client wheel allowlist (new module), two new real paired TLS LAN Core PTY journeys, the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, the settings-catalog terminal test, and existing real-Core cases for the slash menu, settings saves and the multi-select skills/MCP picker with saved readback.
exclusions: No full suites. No native or Playwright changes: only the separate Python terminal client, docs and settings catalog keywords changed; browser viewport projects do not exercise this journey and the catalog change is covered by its Vitest file. tests/test_terminal_pty.py and other tests/v3/test_terminal_core.py cases are not selected: 6 fail identically on pristine origin/main locally, and test_paired_full_screen_tui_shows_progress_and_saved_answer's raw 'YOU · SENDING' expect races Core acceptance against an 80 ms render delay (failed 1 of 6 local runs on pristine main). No live provider calls or Core deployment.
